name: DeploySDG

parameters.description_en: The IDs of instances on which you want to deploy SDGs. You can deploy SDGs on a maximum of 100 instances at a time.
parameters.description_zh: 要部署SDG的设备资源ID列表。支持批量部署，最多一次部署100个Instance。
parameters.help_en: The IDs of instances on which you want to deploy SDGs. You can deploy SDGs on a maximum of 100 instances at a time
parameters.help_zh: 要部署SDG的设备资源ID列表。支持批量部署，最多一次部署100个Instance
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.description_en: The SDG ID. This parameter is used to create a disk, which is attached to an instance.
parameters.description_zh: 使用SDGId创建云盘，并挂载到InstanceId。
parameters.help_en: The SDG ID. This parameter is used to create a disk, which is attached to an instance
parameters.help_zh: 使用SDGId创建云盘，并挂载到InstanceId
parameters.name: sdg_id

parameters.description_en:
The SDG deployment type. Valid values:

- common (default): read/write deployment. Data updates are written to disks.

- overlay: read/write splitting deployment. Content in SDGs is read-only. Data updates are written to the local storage of the instance.
parameters.description_zh:
SDG部署类型，包括：

- common：（默认）可读写部署，数据更新内容会写入云盘。
- overlay：读写分离部署，SDG内容只读，数据更新内容写入实例本地。
